---
name: Bug Report / Rendering Issue
about: Report a file rendering issue, crash, or unexpected behavior in OnePeek
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

**Describe the issue**
A clear description of what went wrong when opening or previewing a file.

**Environment**
- Platform: [e.g. Windows 11 x64 / Android 14]
- OnePeek Version: [e.g. v1.1.3]
- File Format / Extension: [e.g. .dwg, .stp, .cdr, .caj, .dcm]

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Open OnePeek
2. Open file type / feature
3. Observe error or visual mismatch

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to see instead.

**Privacy reminder**
Please do NOT attach confidential CAD drawings, patient DICOM scans, or proprietary documents unless anonymized or recreated with non-sensitive sample data. For private troubleshooting, email [support@onepeek.top](mailto:support@onepeek.top).
